title: S36 — Better deskew: Hough transform + RANSAC for rotated cards (collage family)
desc: Current deskew fails on collage's ±9° rotations. S7b's card de-rotation works but is specific to collage. Method: (1) implement general-purpose deskew using Hough line transform + RANSAC outlier rejection; (2) test on all rotation-family images; (3) measure deskew accuracy (angle error < 1°); (4) if improvement, replace S7b's card-specific deskew with general version. Owner: barry. Priority: 3. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
